summary:
Implementation plan for resolving Cloudflare Worker build failures on full-stack projects:
1. Smart Fallback Adapter with Mock Stubs: Provide intelligent synthetic fallbacks for server-only / Next.js modules and mock unreachable Node/server runtime APIs.
2. Entry Point Prioritization & Internal Tool Filtering: Exclude test harnesses, internal hardening routes, and tool endpoints from entry candidate scoring.
3. Smoke Test Policy with Auto-Bypass & Warnings: Detect simulated/mocked modules and gracefully bypass smoke test with explicit warnings rather than failing.
4. UI Visibility & Clean Feedback: Display detected mock status, entry rationale, and deployment readiness indicators.
